version.description: Accepted versions of the needed pack as a range (e.g. `^1.0`).

$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema for editors; ignored by the game.

dependencies.description: Packs this pack needs; they load before it.

format.description: Version of the pack format (schema version); the current one is 1.

game.description: Supported game versions as a range (e.g. `>=0.1.0, <2.0.0`).

id.description:
Identifier of the pack: 3 to 64 characters `a-z`, `0-9`, `_`, `-`.
Entries are addressed as `<pack>:<entry>`.

version.description: Version of the pack (Semantic Versioning, e.g. `1.2.0`).
